title: Sustained Presence rise precedes deep creative flow
summary: Across three observed sequences, a sustained rise in P (Presence) over 30 or more minutes consistently preceded periods the observer identified as deep creative flow. C (Coherence) also rose in all three cases. E (Entropy) declined. The Q axis was UNKNOWN in one of the three sequences.

findings.text: In all three observed sequences, P rose by at least 0.15 over a window of 30 or more minutes before the observer reported creative flow.
findings.uncertainty: Sample size is three sequences. The threshold of 0.15 is preliminary. P may be rising as a consequence of an unmeasured third factor.

findings.text: C (Coherence) rose alongside P in all three sequences. The two axes moved together within a lag of two observation steps.
findings.uncertainty: Causal direction between P and C is not established. They may both respond to a shared antecedent.

findings.text: In the sequence where Q was UNKNOWN, the transition to creative flow was still observed. Q absence did not block the pattern.
findings.uncertainty: This is a single case. Q may have been present but unmeasured, not absent.

open_questions.question: Is the P rise causal, or does it co-occur with an unmeasured antecedent?
open_questions.note: Requires more sequences and ideally an intervention study.

open_questions.question: What is the role of Q when it is available? Does it modulate the threshold?
open_questions.note: Q data insufficient in current sample.

source_integrity.verification_note: DEEPTheory records patterns. It does not rewrite source packets or temporal sequences.

notes: Illustrates a three-finding recurrence record with one speculative structural finding and two open questions.
